columns.description: Units Sold

columns.name: Order Store Location Type
columns.description: Is this a Store ('ST') or a Warehouse ('WH')

columns.name: Collection
columns.description: ProductID are grouped into a Collection.

columns.name: Category ID Code
columns.description: This is the manufacturing ID code for Retail Category analysis.

columns.name: BrandID
columns.description: This column represents specific categorization within the category.

columns.name: VoidedReasonCodeID
columns.description: This column represents voided codes and is used to provide insight on why the order was canceled. An example of a voided code looks like this VoidedReasonCodeID = DCE. DCE stands for Design Consultant Error

columns.name: Retail Category Description
columns.description: This column is the Retail Category assigned at the time of the sale. It is used for calculating sales performance across categories when the order is written.

columns.name: Fabric/Finish
columns.description: Each SKU may include specific identifiers for fabric or finish, which represent the material applied to the product. This information is valuable for analyzing trends, such as which finishes perform well on wood products or which fabrics are driving sales in upholstered items. By capturing and classifying this metadata, we can surface more meaningful insights, support advanced filtering, and enable targeted recommendations based on material performance across categories.

columns.name: Vendor ID Code
columns.description: This is the Vendor ID (VendorID) code.

columns.name: Customer State
columns.description: This is the state where the customer lives.

columns.name: Season
columns.description: This column represents the overall time of year, such as Winter, Spring, Summer, or Fall. This might give insight into when Customers are looking at particular product.

columns.name: CurrentFiscalWeek
columns.description: This column is a designation that represents the current Fiscal Week that Bassett Furniture is in. It is a rolling field that shows the current fiscal week relative to today's date.\n

columns.name: TransactionFiscalWeek
columns.description: This is the WRITTEN Fiscal Week within which this Transaction occurred.  WRITEN Fiscal Weeks always run Monday to Sunday.

columns.name: KIT_Component_Flag
columns.description: This indicates that this item can be grouped with one or more KITS.

columns.name: WeatherPrecipation
columns.description: This is a value  that has a determination of any rain, snow, etc that occurred when this transaction took place.

columns.name: WeatherTemperature
columns.description: This is a value  that has a determination of the outdoor temperature when this transaction took place.

columns.name: District Manager Region
columns.description: This is the Geographic Region for a transaction.

columns.name: Design Consultant
columns.description: This is the Design Consultant, sometimes called DC or Sales Person. \nWEB SALES it not a DC, rather that is the B2B website.

columns.name: General Manager
columns.description: This column represents the General Manager, who may be in charge of one or more stores.

columns.name: Identified_KitMembership
columns.description: This column shows which all of the KITs this item could possibly be grouped with.

columns.name: Traffic
columns.description: This column is the store traffic, or foot traffic that was monitored by the in-store personnel.

columns.name: Material Type
columns.description: Material Type refers to the primary physical substance or surface covering used in the construction or finish of an item. This classification helps identify whether a product is made of, or upholstered with, materials such as leather, fabric, wood, canvas, or other distinct compositions. In the context of furniture or consumer goods, this metadata field enables more accurate filtering, recommendation, and visual recognition within AI-driven systems. By standardizing material types, we ensure consistency across data sources and enhance the system’s ability to group, tag, and analyze products based on their physical characteristics.\n
